subject: Implementation handoff: Observability onboarding for OliveTech
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Dunne <mark.dunne@olivetech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-18T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Observability onboarding kickoff & handoff materials

Hi Mark —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. I’m starting the formal handoff from Sales to CS/Implementation so we can get the observability integration scheduled. Attached is a short inventory of the telemetry endpoints you shared and a sample of your instrumentation (observability-inventory.csv, olive-infra-telemetry-sample.json).

Proposed next steps:
- Intro kickoff (30–45 min) to align on services, desired dashboards, and alert routing.
- CS to produce an error taxonomy + alerting matrix for your team to review.
- Observability engineer to scaffold dashboards and tracing hooks in our onboarding sandbox.

Can you confirm availability for a kickoff next week (Mon/Tue preferred)? Also please add any internal stakeholders we should include.

Attachments: observability-inventory.csv, olive-infra-telemetry-sample.json

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Mark Dunne <mark.dunne@olivetech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>
Date: 2026-08-18T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff & handoff materials

Hi Karthik —

Thanks, got the files. Priya and I are available Tuesday 8/24 between 10:00–12:00 PT. High-level asks from our side:

- We want two baseline dashboards: (1) request/latency/cost per model route, (2) end-to-end trace for the API + downstream DB calls.
- Sample alert rules for high tail latency and token-cost spikes.
- A clear path to integrate with our PagerDuty rotation and Slack alerts.

Few questions:
1) Does the sandbox use real tokens for performance testing? (we want to avoid sending PII)
2) How will you map our internal service names to Redwood model routes?

Thanks — Mark
Director, Platform Engineering
OliveTech

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Dunne <mark.dunne@olivetech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-19T08:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding kickoff & handoff materials

Great — Tuesday 8/24 10:30 PT works for our team. I’ve put together a short kickoff agenda below and shared a first-pass runbook in Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/obs-handoff/olive-runbook-v1 (internal link).

Kickoff agenda (30–45min):
- 10m: Introductions + success criteria (Karthik, Monica)
- 10m: Telemetry & mapping (Mark, Olive infra leads)
- 10m: Dashboards & tracing plan (Grace, Marissa)
- 10m: Alerts, routing, and runbook ownership (Monica, Olive on-call)
- 5m: Next steps + owners

Notes re: your questions:
1) Sandbox: we will always recommend token redaction for PII. For perf work we can use synthetic payloads and replay traces; we can also run a narrow, consented subset through a staging key if you prefer.
2) Service mapping: we’ll propose an initial mapping based on your inventory file and confirm during the kickoff. We’ll keep a mapping table in the runbook so your team can update names without touching code.

See you Tue 8/24 10:30 PT — calendar invite to follow.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Dunne <mark.dunne@olivetech.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Draft implementation tasks + error taxonomy (for kickoff)

Hi Mark/Priya —

Pre-kickoff, I wanted to share a concise implementation task list and an error taxonomy draft so we can be efficient on Tuesday. Attached is the inventory CSV with our initial mappings and the preliminary taxonomy.

Implementation tasks (initial sprint):
- CS: Confirm success criteria and escalation contacts (owner: Olive)
- Observability: Scaffold two dashboards (model routes + E2E traces) in onboarding sandbox (owner: Marissa)
- Instrumentation: Add tracing hooks around auth, inference, and DB access points (owner: Olive infra)
- Alerts: Propose alert thresholds for 95/99 latency, token-cost deltas, and error-rate spikes (owner: Monica/Marissa)
- Runbook: Populate runbook sections: incident triage, contact matrix, rollback steps, and post-incident review template (owner: Monica)

Error taxonomy (high level):
- client_validation_error: malformed requests, missing params
- inference_timeout: model latency exceeded SLO
- downstream_db_error: DB connection failures / timeouts
- integrity_mismatch: tokenization/serialization errors

Alert routing proposal:
- P0 (system-wide outage) -> PagerDuty escalation (on-call) + #platform-alerts Slack channel
- P1 (service degradation) -> Primary on-call + CS escalation to Monica
- P2 (minor) -> Email digest to ops and weekly review

Please review and flag anything missing. We’ll capture final thresholds during kickoff based on your traffic patterns.

Attachments: handoff-runbook-v1.md, observability-inventory.csv

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Mark Dunne <mark.dunne@olivetech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T18:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft implementation tasks + error taxonomy (for kickoff)

Thanks Monica — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications before the call: 

- For sandbox perf tests: we’ll opt for synthetic payloads only; no prod tokens to be used.
- For alert thresholds: how will you translate token-cost deltas into a dollar-based alert? Our finance team wants to understand when cost exceeds X% month-over-month.
- On-call: we currently have a PagerDuty rotation but would like Redwood to post incidents to our Slack #ops channel and create a ticket in Jira (OLV-ops) automatically. Is that supported?

Also, who will own the runbook after handoff? We’d prefer Olive to be the primary owner but Redwood to retain an editable copy for support.

Thanks — Priya
VP, Engineering Operations
OliveTech

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Mark Dunne <mark.dunne@olivetech.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@olivetech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft implementation tasks + error taxonomy (for kickoff)

Perfect questions — quick answers before Tuesday: 

- Sandbox: agreed, synthetic payloads only. We’ll provide a small CSV-based workload generator for replay.
- Cost alerts: Marissa will add a cost delta metric that maps tokens -> estimated USD using your published pricing tier. We’ll add a configurable alert that triggers when daily or weekly cost moves >X% vs baseline; finance-facing reports can be exported from the dashboard.
- Integrations: Yes — we support Slack webhooks, PagerDuty, and Jira ticket creation via our onboarding connector. We’ll wire the OliveTeam-PD rotation to your PagerDuty project and configure auto-ticket creation in OLV-ops.
- Runbook ownership: Olive will be the primary owner post-handoff. Redwood will maintain an editable canonical copy and a read-only snapshot for audits. We’ll record ownership in the runbook metadata.

Action items (owners):
- Marissa Cole: scaffold dashboards + cost metric, prepare tracing hook examples (owner: marissa_cole@redwood.ai)
- Monica Patel: finalize alert thresholds and runbook sections (owner: monica_patel@redwood.ai)
- Olive infra: confirm service mapping and provide consented staging key if required (owner: Mark/Priya)
- Karthik: finalize kickoff invite (sent) and keep execs looped for any SLA questions

See the calendar invite for Tue 8/24 10:30 PT. I’ll bring Marissa and Grace; Monica will lead the runbook discussion.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
